name: Smokemistress Alba
title: The Smokehouse School
examine: Smoke has cured her voice down to the useful words. Every cook in the south learned the slow fire from her, or from someone who did.
lines: Low fire. Long patience. That's the whole secret, and it still takes years.
Gut it clean, salt it honest, and don't open the door to check. Checking is how you feed the dog.
Cooking is a trade. Anyone who tells you otherwise has been eating badly.
